xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4529: Evaluate Claude Code mods for Overdeck: in-depth report (evaluation only, no adoption)

plan.title: Evaluate Claude Code mods for Overdeck: in-depth report (evaluation only, no adoption)
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.docsJustification: This change alters no documented surface: it adds an evaluation report under .pan/drafts/ and no user or developer doc describes a mods integration. The report itself is the documentation deliverable, and the PR body states this.
metadata.sizeJustification: Thirteen serial items all edit one report file; they are sections of one indivisible deliverable.

narratives.Problem: Claude Code 2.1.287 added mods (in-process function-hook plugins that draw panes, bands and status entries and can rewrite or answer tool calls, prompts and turns). Overdeck reaches into Claude Code from outside today: shell settings hooks, keystroke/paste delivery, pane scraping, transcript markers and a bash status line. The operator needs an in-depth, review-ready evaluation of where mods could replace or improve these paths, their hard limits and risks, and what to adopt first, with no adoption in this issue.
narratives.Proposal: Write a Markdown report (source of truth) and a self-contained HTML copy under .pan/drafts/, built on the verified research brief and the PRD's verified evidence map. Seven candidate sections follow a fixed table template (capability, Overdeck evidence with path:line anchors, parity, risk, size, sources, verdict) so acceptance is mechanically checkable. A throwaway band-mod probe runs only claude plugin validate and test in /tmp/pan-4529-mods-scratch. The report ends with a ranked recommendation and one or two proposed follow-up issues, then is published as an artifact when the tool exists.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to production code, configuration, sync sources, installed plugins, settings hooks or ~/.claude
- No mod loaded into any live session; nothing written under ~/.claude/dev-mods/; no --plugin-dir, /reload-plugins or nested claude -p
- No follow-up issues filed (proposed only)
- No live probe of the peer-socket protocol or Herdr fullscreen behavior; both stay UNVERIFIED open questions
- No edits to .pan/drafts/claude-code-mods-research.md
- No messages to live agents and no POSTs to the dashboard

autoDecisions.summary: Build the plan on the Flywheel-supplied research brief and commit it unmodified with the report
autoDecisions.rationale: The Flywheel relayed this on the operator's request mid-planning; the planner verified its load-bearing claims against the cited sources (PRD table) so re-research would waste the work agent's time.

autoDecisions.summary: Markdown is the source of truth; HTML is rendered from the finished Markdown
autoDecisions.rationale: One source prevents the two deliverables drifting, and the PR review reads the Markdown.

autoDecisions.summary: Serial item chain over one report file
autoDecisions.rationale: Every item mutates the same file; edges encode that shared mutation. Read-only research subagents may still run ahead.

autoDecisions.summary: Prototype limited to claude plugin validate and claude plugin test in /tmp/pan-4529-mods-scratch
autoDecisions.rationale: The work session is a managed session; writing to ~/.claude/dev-mods would load the mod into it, and a nested claude -p would trip Overdeck's own hooks. Both are forbidden by the issue.

autoDecisions.summary: Scope Claude Code bug #92533 to Agent isolation: worktree subagents
autoDecisions.rationale: The bug body shows it is triggered by Claude Code's own worktree isolation for subagents; Overdeck prompts do not request that isolation (grep), but agents can choose it, so it blocks a Bash tool.call git-guard mod.

autoDecisions.summary: Fixed nine-row candidate template and a path:line + anchor checker script
autoDecisions.rationale: Makes FR-1..FR-3 mechanically checkable by review and test roles without judgment calls.
